name: Rajma Galouti Kebab

ingredients.name: canned kidney beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Dry-roast gram flour over low heat for 4 minutes, stirring until fragrant. Transfer to a bowl and cool.
Finely chop onion, ginger and garlic. Cook onion in 15 ml oil for 7 minutes until golden; add ginger and garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add drained beans, all spices and salt. Stir for 5 minutes until dry, then cool and blend to a smooth, thick paste without adding water.
Mix in roasted gram flour, lemon juice and finely chopped coriander. Divide into 12 portions and gently form soft patties about 1.5 cm thick.
Heat remaining 25 ml oil on a nonstick griddle across batches. Cook patties over medium-low heat for 3 minutes per side until browned, turning only after a crust forms. Serve hot.
tips: Use fully cooked, very soft beans and grind finely for a delicate galouti texture.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
